p: not: That is, they receive not the fruit of that which they see and hear.
sign to the house of Israel: That as you do, so shall they do, and therefore in you they will see their own plague and punishment.
doest thou: Do they not deride your doings?
him: When the king will think to escape by fleeing, I will take him into my net, as in Eze 32:3.
few men of them from the: Who would bear his Name, and would be his Church.
are prolonged: Because they did not immediately see the prophecies accomplished, they contemned them as though they would never be fulfilled.
many days to come: That is, it will not come to pass in our days, and therefore we care not for it: thus the wicked ever abuse God's patience and benignity.
